g.text: DIFFUSION POLICY: CONTINUOUS ACTION CHUNK DENOISING
First-Principles Mechanism: Symmetry Breaking over Multimodal Demonstrations, Iterative Denoising Steps, and Receding Horizons
Standard BC: Naive MSE Centroid Averaging
Loss: ℒ = 𝔼[||a_demo - π_θ(s)||^2] forces mean prediction:
FAIL: Minimizing MSE over multimodal data
Predicts noise ϵ_θ(A^k, O, k) added to trajectory chunk:
SUCCESS: Gaussian noise is strictly unimodal.
Sampling breaks symmetry; reverse drift guides
sample into one mode without averaging.
Multimodal Conditioning Features: O_t = {E_vis, q_t, k}
Conditioning vector injects wrist camera, shoulder camera, and joint angles into U-Net.
Step k = 16: Pure Gaussian Latent Noise (A^16 ~ 𝒩(0, I))
DDIM Step: A^10 = f(A^16, ϵ_θ, O_t)
Step k = 10: Global Mode Emergence & Low-Frequency Flow
DDIM Step: A^4 = f(A^10, ϵ_θ, O_t)
Step k = 4: Kinematic Smoothing & Inter-Joint Alignment
Step k = 0: Certified Action Chunk A^0 ∈ ℝ^(H × D_a)
Cadence Gap: Brain 25 Hz vs Motor 1 kHz
Linux Brain publishes H_a chunk into lock-free
SRAM ring buffer with monotonically rising sequence.
MCU samples at 1 kHz with cubic spline interpolation.
Motor loop never starved of setpoints
Core Physical AI Systems Principle: Generative Diffusion Decoupled from Physical Servo Deadlines
1. Diffusion policies formulate multimodal action generation as score-based denoising over continuous multi-step chunks, eliminating behavioral cloning mode collapse without centroid averaging.

2. Action chunking amortizes heavy visual feature extraction and iterative denoising latency across a multi-step horizon, enabling a 25 Hz neural deliberator to feed a 1000 Hz safety-governed motor loop.
